Group-size theory by Peña–Nöldeke does treat explicit size dependence but has no matching exponentially variable stochastic group-type mixture; the present theorem needs direct asymptotic root bracketing.

Previous group-size results can handle some size-dependent gains, but no examined primary text supplies the specific coupled limit with exponentially rare synergistic groups, a sharp rarity-base transition and two noncommensurate critical boundary layers. value.rationale: Quantifies whether exponentially improbable synergistic group events can sustain a macroscopic all-cooperation basin as group size rises, identifies the sharp rarity exponent log(1+δ), and resolves its nontrivial critical amplitude with a second exponentially narrow basin layer. These statements address stochastic nonlinear public-good cooperation and are not arbitrary numerical parameter cuts.
